gotchas.procedure_section: Review - Kid Taxes and Filings (separate client ID / project code)
gotchas.title: Child needs his own return
gotchas.trap: Report Ethan's income on the parents' Form 8814 like 2024, or skip his return because 'he's a dependent'.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Capital gain from a sale + wages -> Form 8814 not allowed. Unearned income $6,400 > $1,350 filing threshold and > $2,700 kiddie threshold -> separate Form 1040 with Form 8615, under its own client ID (EVG1021) and 1040 project code, after discussing with parents.

gotchas.procedure_section: Kid Taxes - Form 8615 using parents' return
gotchas.title: Parents' rate from the FINAL parents' return
gotchas.trap: Tax all of Ethan's income at his own 10%/0% rates, or use an estimated/prior-year parent taxable income.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Form 8615 line 6 = parents' 2025 taxable income $402,319 (EVG1010, MFJ); line 10 = parents' tax $80,830 excluding the $55 Form 8814 tax. NUI $3,700 taxed at the parents' marginal rates -> $628. If the parents' return changes (amended), Ethan's return must be amended too.

gotchas.title: Preferential rates keep applying inside Form 8615
gotchas.trap: Tax the whole $3,700 of NUI at the parents' top bracket (their taxable income is in the 32% bracket).
gotchas.correct_treatment: The share of qualified dividends (1,098.44) and capital gain (1,792.19) included in NUI (line 5 / line 1) is taxed at the parents' 15% capital gain rate on line 9. The ordinary part is taxed at 24%, not 32%: the parents' ORDINARY income (TI less QD/CG = $386,538) is in the 24% bracket because the QDCG worksheet stacks QD/CG on top. The rest of the child's QD/CG is taxed at his own 0% rate on line 15.
gotchas.impact: Line 11 $628 vs $1,184 if all NUI at 32%

gotchas.title: Dependent standard deduction
gotchas.trap: Use the full $15,750 single standard deduction (-> $0 taxable income), or the $1,350 minimum ignoring wages.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Dependent: greater of $1,350 or earned income + $450 = $3,650 (capped at $15,750). Taxable income $5,950.

gotchas.title: Only unearned income is subject to kiddie tax
gotchas.trap: Include the $3,200 lifeguard wages in Form 8615 line 1.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Line 1 = unearned income only ($900 + $2,400 + $3,100 = $6,400). Wages are taxed at the child's own rates (line 14/15).

gotchas.title: Dependent checkbox / no credits for the child
gotchas.trap: Leave the 'can be claimed as a dependent' box unchecked, or claim his own personal credits.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Check the box on page 1 (the parents claim him and the CTC). No CTC/EITC on his return; Form 8615 lists the parent's name/SSN. Balance due $642 < $1,000 and no 2024 liability -> no Form 2210.

software_exceptions.title: Form 8615 parent figures - stale 2024 data / manual entry; must match the FINAL EVG1010 return
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Form 8615 uses the parent's taxable income, filing status and tax entered on the child's return. The first draft carried the parents' 2024 taxable income ($357,750) because EVG1010 was not final; the calculation runs without a diagnostic once any parent figure is present. Entering the parents' line 16 including the $55 Form 8814 tax for Chloe also overstates line 10.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Form 8615 (Kiddie tax) input: parents Daniel & Grace Kim, MFJ, 2025 taxable income $402,319, qualified dividends $5,904, net capital gain $9,877, tax $80,830 (excluding the $55 Form 8814 tax); no other children's NUI (Chloe is on Form 8814). Result: tax on NUI $628 + $14 = $642 (line 16). Release only after EVG1010 is locked/accepted (verify field names in current release).
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: ProConnect has no Family Link (that is a Lacerte feature); the parent's information is not pulled from the parents' return. Without it, diagnostic ref 826 ('Form 8615 must be filed') appears and the tax cannot be computed correctly.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Taxes > Children Under 18 (8615) > Parent's Information: enter the parents' names/SSN, filing status MFJ, taxable income 402,319, tax 80,830, and the qualified dividend / capital gain figures; update manually if EVG1010 changes.
software_exceptions.proconnect_reference: Intuit help: 'How do you generate Form 8615 in ProConnect Tax'; 'resolve diagnostic Ref 826'
software_exceptions.efile_impact: None (transmit after EVG1010 is accepted - duplicate-dependent reject risk otherwise)
software_exceptions.notes: If EVG1010 is ever amended, Ethan's Form 8615 must be recomputed and his return amended.

software_exceptions.title: 'Can be claimed as a dependent' box - dependent standard deduction $3,650
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Unless the 'can be claimed as a dependent' indicator is checked on the child's return, Axcess gives the full single standard deduction ($15,750) -> taxable income $0 and Form 8615 has nothing to tax.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: General > Basic Data: check 'Taxpayer can be claimed as a dependent'. Standard deduction = greater of $1,350 or earned income $3,200 + $450 = $3,650; taxable income $5,950.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - the dependent standard deduction applies only when the 'can be claimed as a dependent' box is checked.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: General > Taxpayer information: 'Can be claimed as a dependent on another return' = Yes (field per current release - verify).

software_exceptions.title: Form 8814 rolled forward on the parents' return although Ethan no longer qualifies
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: The parents' 2024 return reported Ethan's UTMA income on Form 8814; proforma carries that 8814 input into EVG1010 for 2025. Nothing tests the 8814 eligibility rules (only interest/dividends, gross income < $13,500, no estimates/withholding) against the capital-gain sale and summer wages, so his income could be reported on the wrong return.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: EVG1010: delete Ethan's Form 8814 input (keep Chloe's). Set up EVG1021 as its own client/return: unearned income $6,400 (interest $900 + dividends $2,400 + LTCG $3,100) > $2,700 -> Form 8615 on Ethan's own 1040.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - a Form 8814 entry carried forward on the parents' return is not tested against the child's other income.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Parents' return: remove Ethan's 8814 entry (Taxes > Children's Interest and Dividends, screen per current release - verify); prepare Ethan's own 1040 with Form 8615.
